sql: WITH base AS(SELECT DISTINCT session,stamp,path FROM activity_log WHERE action='view'), w AS(SELECT session,stamp,path,LEAD(path) OVER(PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp,path) p2,LEAD(path,2) OVER(PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp,path) p3 FROM base) SELECT p3,COUNT(*) n FROM w WHERE path='/detail' AND p2='/detail' AND p3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p3 ORDER BY n DESC,p3
